_comment: Symbols deliberately not behaviour-tested by this harness. coverage-audit.mjs subtracts these from both the blocking and backlog counts, so the gap can legitimately reach zero. Every entry needs a real reason. Never add one to silence a gap you simply have not got to yet -- untested-but-tractable belongs in the backlog, not here.

exclusions.reason: Emits TypeScript source from a contract spec. Testing it means asserting on generated code text, which is a codegen test rather than validation that the SDK works for a consumer -- the question this harness exists to answer. Brittle against any formatting change in the emitter.
exclusions.revisitIf: The generated bindings become something this harness consumes and executes, rather than only text the CLI writes out.
